I am getting old now, 58 years, but with God's help I still work my land. This small rice plot is only a quarter hectare, so I cannot spend much money on it. I will buy a little DAP and urea like the extension worker tells us, because without fertilizer the soil here is tired. I keep my cattle near the house, so I spread their manure before ploughing. For seed I use what I saved from last harvest — the improved rice seed is expensive and not always available in our woreda. The rain comes when it comes; I have no pump, no canal. My wife and my son help me, and at harvest I call neighbors and pay some with food and a little money.
